boards.title: 10 Blocks Off Campus, One Reason Each
boards.description: Ten named Kirksville destinations on nearby downtown and Baltimore Street corridors, each with a documented reason to stop.

cards.title: Gallery 104
cards.subtitle: North Franklin Street corridor, downtown Kirksville
cards.notes: Walk the North Franklin Street corridor to see Gallery 104’s local and regional art, crafts, student work, and scheduled art classes.
cards.short_summary: A downtown gallery and shop with student work and classes.
cards.evidence_claim: Gallery 104 sells local and regional art and crafts, displays local student work, offers art classes, and participates in downtown events.
cards.access_notes: Listed at 104 N. Franklin St.; check the gallery’s current schedule before visiting.

cards.title: Sue Ross Arts Center
cards.subtitle: South Franklin Street corridor, downtown Kirksville
cards.notes: Use the South Franklin Street corridor for a gallery stop, then look for Arts Association exhibits or community arts programming.
cards.short_summary: The downtown home of Kirksville Arts Association gallery activity.
cards.evidence_claim: The Kirksville Arts Association hosts gallery exhibits and arts programs at the Sue Ross Arts Center and produces community arts events.
cards.access_notes: Listed at 215 S. Franklin St.; exhibition and program access varies by schedule.

cards.title: Downtown Cinema 8
cards.subtitle: North Elson Street corridor, west side of the Square
cards.notes: Head to North Elson Street for a current film showing; confirm the rating and showtime online before committing to a screening.
cards.short_summary: A multi-screen cinema on the west side of downtown’s Square.
cards.evidence_claim: Downtown Cinema 8 is located at 115 N. Elson St. on the west side of the Square and publishes current showtimes.
cards.access_notes: Listed at 115 N. Elson St.; choose an age-appropriate, currently scheduled film.

cards.title: Rotary Park
cards.subtitle: East Mill Street and Baltimore Street corridor
cards.notes: Take the Baltimore Street corridor to Rotary Park for its playground, disc-golf course, picnic shelters, and amphitheatre grounds.
cards.short_summary: A city park with recreation facilities beside the Baltimore Street corridor.
cards.evidence_claim: Rotary Park has picnic shelters, restrooms, a playground, the Ray Klinginsmith Amphitheatre, and a nine-hole disc golf course.
cards.source_title: Parks, Trails & Facilities | City of Kirksville
cards.access_notes: Listed at 801 E. Mill St.; facility use and event access can vary.

cards.title: Adair County Veterans Memorial Plaza
cards.subtitle: North Baltimore Street corridor
cards.notes: Pause along the North Baltimore Street corridor to view the memorial wall, granite tablets, obelisk, and historic military artifacts.
cards.short_summary: A memorial plaza with regional veterans’ names and historic artifacts.
cards.evidence_claim: The plaza includes a veterans memorial wall, granite tablets, an obelisk, a World War I German howitzer, and a Civil War-era cannon.
cards.source_title: Parks, Trails & Facilities | City of Kirksville
cards.access_notes: Listed at 1201 N. Baltimore St.; outdoor memorial features are described by the City.

cards.title: Brashear Park
cards.subtitle: East Normal Street and Baltimore Street corridor
cards.notes: Follow the Baltimore Street corridor to Brashear Park for the gazebo, basketball and pickleball court, playground, and seasonal wading pool.
cards.short_summary: A neighborhood park with courts, a gazebo, and seasonal water play.
cards.evidence_claim: Brashear Park has a gazebo, playground, basketball court with pickleball lines, picnic shelter, and seasonal wading pool.
cards.source_title: Parks, Trails & Facilities | City of Kirksville
cards.access_notes: Listed at 1415 E. Normal St.; the wading pool is seasonal.

cards.title: Memorial Park
cards.subtitle: East Cottonwood Street corridor
cards.notes: Use the East Cottonwood Street corridor for a short outdoor break with a walking loop, basketball and pickleball court, and playground.
cards.short_summary: A compact city park with a walkable loop and multi-use court.
cards.evidence_claim: Memorial Park has a covered picnic shelter, basketball court with pickleball lines, playground, restrooms, and a 0.15-mile walking path.
cards.source_title: Parks, Trails & Facilities | City of Kirksville
cards.access_notes: Listed at 404 E. Cottonwood St.; outdoor amenities are maintained by the City.

cards.title: Detweiler Park
cards.subtitle: East McPherson Street corridor
cards.notes: Walk the East McPherson Street corridor to see the park’s concrete paths and gazebo built with recycled materials at the former high-school site.
cards.short_summary: A newer park on the former Kirksville High School site.
cards.evidence_claim: Dedicated in 2023 at the old Kirksville High School site, Detweiler Park features concrete walkways and a gazebo made from recycled materials.
cards.source_title: Parks, Trails & Facilities | City of Kirksville
cards.access_notes: Listed at 411 E. McPherson St.; outdoor features are described by the City.

cards.title: FLATS Trailhead & Rotary Nature Playscape
cards.subtitle: North Osteopathy Street corridor
cards.notes: Use the North Osteopathy Street corridor to access the ADA-suitable FLATS trail for a walk, jog, or bike ride from the trailhead.
cards.short_summary: A trailhead and nature-play stop with an ADA-suitable route.
cards.evidence_claim: The FLATS Trailhead & Rotary Nature Playscape has outdoor play fixtures and an ADA-accessible trail suitable for walking, jogging, or biking.
cards.source_title: Parks, Trails & Facilities | City of Kirksville
cards.access_notes: Listed at 105 N. Osteopathy St.; use the route within your comfort and mobility needs.

cards.title: Adair County Public Library
cards.subtitle: Library Lane and Baltimore Street corridor
cards.notes: Make a Library Lane stop for an indoor study or reading session; verify the day’s service hours before walking over.
cards.short_summary: The county public library near the Baltimore Street corridor.
cards.evidence_claim: Adair County Public Library is at One Library Lane in Kirksville and publishes weekday and Saturday operating hours.
cards.source_title: Our Locations & Hours | Adair County Public Library
cards.access_notes: Listed at One Library Lane; published hours vary by day and the library is closed Sundays.
